role: Graduate civil or environmental engineer - expression of interest (Kew)
subject: Graduate civil engineer EOI, Kew, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am sending my CV for your graduate recruitment in Kew. Your careers page says you are actively recruiting graduates to start as soon as possible.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as field engineer and project-in-charge.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for office and site work across Melbourne.

Your landfill civil and geoenvironmental work for Victorian councils and operators is the consulting start I am seeking. I do not yet have Australian landfill consulting employment, so I am looking for mentoring on practical design and documentation.

I have attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

macdarenz@gmail.com

paragraphs: I am applying for your graduate recruitment in Kew. Your careers page asks graduates to send a CV to enquiries@mackenviro.com.au and says you are recruiting graduates to start as soon as possible.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language. Coursework covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, plus Before You Dig Australia enquiries and design around existing services. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi in the Philippines (2014 to 2019).

From April to September 2019 I was project-in-charge engineer at JustBuilt on a community hall renovation, coordinating crews and checking work against drawings. From September 2019 to February 2020 I was field engineer at Grand Travaux on residential subdivision finishing works, assisting with inspections, materials tracking and progress reports.

I live in Melton, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for office and site work. I do not yet have Australian landfill consulting employment, and I am seeking structured mentoring on design drawings and site support.
I have attached my resume. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
